units.text: INT. HOSPITAL LAUNDRY ROOM - NIGHT
Industrial washers thump in the dark.
Steam.
A folding table piled with scrub tops.
DR. ISOLDE NWOSU (40s, surgical cap, tired eyes) sits on an upturned basket with a paper cup of coffee.
NURSE BEAUMONT (50s, reading glasses) folds towels.
KEOLA (20s, orderly, earbuds around his neck) feeds a load into a dryer.
Across the table, DR. MARCHETTI (60s, bow tie, chief of surgery) peels an orange.
You could go home, Doctor.
units.name: BEAUMONT

units.text: I could. The couch there is cold.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Cold is a good thing in a couch. Keeps one from sleeping through the pager.
units.name: MARCHETTI

units.text: Wait. Dr. Marchetti, you actually sleep on a couch?
units.name: KEOLA

units.text: Twenty-six years. I've got a recliner at the hospital and a bed at home I haven't seen since March.
units.name: MARCHETTI

units.text: That's grim.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: It's tidy. A bed gets mussed. A recliner just waits.
units.name: MARCHETTI

units.text: He's lying. His wife bought him a very nice bed.
units.name: BEAUMONT

units.text: My wife is a tyrant who loves me. Keola, is the dryer on four done?
units.name: MARCHETTI

units.text: Eleven more minutes.
units.name: KEOLA

units.text: Wonderful. Eleven more minutes of this.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: The door swings in.
ZHANG (30s, pharmacist's coat, a clipboard with a tied-on pen) enters, scanning the room.
Sorry. I'm looking for Dr. Nwosu. Bed twelve needs a sign-off on the morphine.
units.name: ZHANG

units.text: That's me.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: She drains her coffee, takes the clipboard, signs.
Zhang nods and leaves.
The door sighs shut.
Quiet night.
units.name: MARCHETTI

units.text: Don't say that.
units.name: BEAUMONT
